description: A helper utility class that provides static methods for Android logging, acting as a wrapper around android.util.Log and enabling chaining of LogNodes for customizable log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class for managing logging in Android, providing static methods for different log levels and chaining LogNodes.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain for log output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches log messages to the LogNode chain with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, with overloads for message and Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assert-level message, with overloads for message and Throwable.
